global_rules.expiry: Barriers last through the next complete hostile Forecast resolution window after application. Armor break lasts through the next friendly damage window; slow/threat affect the next not-yet-committed hostile Forecast only. Native window IDs must be bound and persisted; do not tick twice, reorder committed actions, or extend duration with rank.
global_rules.input_limits: 64 target records, 3 bursts, 2 channels are bounded read sizes, not a roster cap
